title: DEPHYRIER Drive Ishara (Notification Not Content)
style: privacy pulse 92 bpm trilingual EN AR FR DEPHYRIER signature notification-not-content surface-only-tone soft-pad upright-bass spoken-arabic ledger-tone
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Drive notifications turned on in the workspace stream
New comments access requests files shared seam
The surface is public app to user not the doc inside
Read the integration card not the body inside

[Pre-Chorus — Arabic transliteration]
Ishārāt Drive maftuha 'alā al-tasjeel
(Drive notifications open on the log)
Lā taqra' al-mahtawá bālé wa-lā daleel
(Don't read the contents without proof and without guide)

[Chorus — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER notification yes content no
Drive ishāra na'm al-mahtawá lā
(Drive notification yes content no)
Notification oui contenu non
(Notification yes content no)

[Verse 2]
A notification is a metadata flag
A file body is a payload that the privacy can drag
Reading the surface is the public app lane
Reading the body needs consent in plain

[Bridge — French]
La notification est publique pas le contenu
(The notification is public not the content)
Le corps du fichier reste retenu
(The file body remains held back)

[Outro — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER notification surface only
Drive ishāra na'm contenido no
DEPHYRIER notification oui contenu non
